statements.statement: The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient reports recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient had one recent event of syncope
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) was billed
The service was billed with diagnosis codes I48.0, R42, and R55
The claim was denied under reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
The service directly addresses the documented symptoms and arrhythmia evaluation
